details:
This update for ImageMagick fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-93586: use-after-free in the `ImagesToBlob` method can lead to a process crash (bsc#1281912).
- CVE-2026-106565: a missing end-of-file check while reading bzip2-compressed image data can cause an infinite loop
  (bsc#1284662).
- CVE-2026-106567: a crafted PSD file can trigger an integer-conversion error in the PSD decoder, causing an infinite
  loop and DoS (bsc#1284664).
- CVE-2026-106568: a crafted XMP profile embedded in an image can cause the profile parser to enter an infinite loop
  (bsc#1284665).
- CVE-2026-106571: a crafted local call to the GetVirtualPixels API can trigger an integer calculation error and write
  beyond a heap buffer, crashing the server process (bsc#1284668).
- CVE-2026-106572: a missing recursion-depth check in the CALS decoder allows a crafted CALS image to exhaust the call
  stack and terminate the process (bsc#1284669).
- CVE-2026-106577: unescaped or untrimmed values can inject code into output generated by PostScript coders
  (bsc#1284675).
- CVE-2026-106579: a crafted image can bypass an ImageMagick security policy that uses coder as its domain, potentially
  allowing data prohibited by the policy to be read (bsc#1284678).
- CVE-2026-106580: a missing security-policy check in the CUT encoder allows a crafted local encoding operation to read
  data that policy should deny and can also cause a crash (bsc#1284680).
- CVE-2026-107208: a crafted XMP profile can reach a recursion limit that is handled as a fatal condition instead of an
  ordinary exception, terminating the image-processing process (bsc#1284681).
- CVE-2026-107209: when ImageMagick is built without Cairo support, a crafted RSVG image that reaches a resource limit
  can cause a crash (bsc#1284682).
- CVE-2026-107210: a crafted highly compressed MAT image can make the MAT decoder create temporary files larger than the
  configured security-policy limit (bsc#1284683).
- CVE-2026-109259: Information disclosure via crafted TGA image (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109260: Denial of Service via memory leak in PNG encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109261: Denial of Service via memory leak in GIF encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109262: Denial of Service via memory leak in SVG encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109263: Denial of Service via memory leak in YUV encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109266: XML injection vulnerability in the CIP encoder (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109269: Information disclosure via crafted JPEG file (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109273: Information disclosure via crafted PostScript file (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109275: Code injection via crafted MVG file (bsc#1285071).
- CVE-2026-109276: Denial of Service via temporary file leak in JNG decoder (bsc#1285071).
